account.title: My account
account.microsoftManaged: You sign in with your Microsoft account. Your password is managed by Microsoft (Office 365).

info.title: About this installation
info.upToDate: You are running the latest version.
info.downgradeAvailable: Production version {{version}} is available (switch back from test).
info.installing: Installing update… the application restarts automatically.
info.devBuild: This is a development build. Updates can only be installed on a packaged installation.

channel.productionHint: Stable releases. Recommended for live broadcasting.
channel.testHint: Pre-releases for testing new features before they go to production.

updates.title: Software & updates
updates.intro: Choose the release channel and install updates from GitHub releases.
updates.tokenHint: Only needed when the repository is private (fine-grained token with read access to Contents).
updates.autoCheck: Check for updates automatically every 6 hours

mail.title: Mail server
mail.intro: Outgoing mail (SMTP) used for alerts and notifications.
mail.alertRecipientsHint: Comma separated. Receives backup failures, node alerts and update notices.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.intro: Full and incremental backups to remote FTP, FTPS or SCP locations.
backup.hostKeyHint: Filled in automatically on the first successful test.
backup.cronHint: Cron format: minute hour day month weekday. Default: full on Sunday 03:00, incremental the other days.
backup.retentionHint: Older full backups and their incrementals are removed from the remote location.
backup.restoreIntro: Pick a location to list the backups stored there. This also works on a fresh installation.
backup.restoreConfirm: Restore the backup from {{date}}? Current data is replaced and the application restarts.
backup.restoring: Restoring… the application restarts and you will need to sign in again.
backup.noRemote: No backups found at this location.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Who can sign in, and what they may do.
users.rolesHelp: Administrators manage the system, editors plan the broadcast, operators run the control room.

roleHelp.admin: Everything, including mail, backups, updates and users.
roleHelp.editor: Media, blocks, schedule, EPG, graphics and the control room.
roleHelp.operator: Control room only; can view the schedule.

errors.username_taken: This username is already in use.
errors.last_admin: There must be at least one administrator.
errors.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.validation_failed: Check the fields: username at least 3 characters, password at least 10.
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least 10 characters.
errors.sso_account: Microsoft accounts have no password here.

users.entraHint: The user's Office 365 address, e.g. jan@example.com. They sign in with Microsoft; no password is stored here.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.intro: Let people sign in with their Office 365 account (Microsoft Entra ID). Local accounts keep working as a fallback.
sso.tenantIdHint: Entra admin center → App registrations → your app → Overview.
sso.clientIdHint: Shown on the same Overview page.
sso.clientSecretHint: The secret Value (not the Secret ID), from Certificates & secrets.
sso.registrationIntro: Add this address in Entra under Authentication → Web → Redirect URIs.
sso.redirectUriHint: Must match exactly, including https and the port.
sso.publicUrlHint: Only needed when the address above is wrong, for example behind a reverse proxy.
sso.httpsRequired: Microsoft only accepts https redirect addresses (except localhost). Put this app behind a reverse proxy with a certificate and fill in the public address.
sso.autoCreateHint: On the first Microsoft sign-in. Off: add people on the Users page first (sign-in: Microsoft).
sso.defaultRoleAppRoles: Not used: the role comes from Entra app roles.
sso.allowedDomainsHint: Comma separated. Empty: every account in your tenant.
sso.useAppRoles: Take roles from Entra app roles
sso.useAppRolesHint: The role is updated on every sign-in. People without a role cannot sign in.
sso.testOk: Connection OK: tenant, client ID and client secret are accepted by Microsoft.
sso.fallback: The local administrator account keeps working with its password, also when Microsoft is unreachable. Sign out and use "Sign in with a local account" on the login page.

errors.tenant_id_guid: The tenant ID must be the Directory (tenant) ID, a GUID like 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.
errors.sso_incomplete: Fill in tenant ID, client ID and client secret before enabling.
